knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A conflict is escalated and recorded, and the approved product is used until the standard is formally changed.
Checklists, training and visit records make the standard checkable at each site.
Site-specific rules belong in the site schedule, so that the common standard stays a single controlled document.

practicalCriteria: Separates the common standard from site rules in a sample set of records, with a version and date on the standard.
Escalates a simulated product conflict and records the decision and the person who made it.
Produces a checklist for one task that works at two sites, with the same completion test at each.
passRule: Standard and site rules separated, conflict escalated and recorded, and checklist produced for two sites. Observed in a desk exercise. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Common standard and site schedule records
stopWorkCriteria: Unapproved product used on a site rule alone
Common standard changed at one site without the approved route
